title: Grey Literature Resources generate and drive Awareness to the Circular Economy

contacts.name: D.  Farace
contacts.affiliation: GreyNet International, Grey Literature Network Service

descriptions: This study first sets out to gain insight into the opinions of GreyNet’s community of practice with regard to the circular economy and to determine if there is consensus. This will be carried out via an online community-based survey. As with any explorative research, the outcome has yet to be fully defined. Nevertheless, it is expected that the findings of the survey will indicate a sufficient level of consensus within GreyNet’s community of practice.
